data.narrative:
Orbital Sidekick is a Series C-stage space and aerospace company that has raised $47.5M to date. The valuation analysis employs two applicable triangulation methods against a peer set of 7 private companies in the same sector and stage, supplemented by 5 public Space & Aerospace comparables (RKLB, PL, LUNR, ASTS, SATL).

Stage-progression analysis applies a 1.7x multiplier to the $48M total raised proxy, implying a $81M valuation. Peer-median analysis across 7 same-sector, same/adjacent-stage private companies yields a median valuation of $2.0B, with a range spanning $1.15B to $8.0B. The sample includes Sierra Space at $8.0B (Series C), Impulse Space at $4.3B (Series D), Apex Space at $2.3B (Series D), Cowboy Space Corporation at $2.0B (Series B), and Varda Space Industries at $1.6B (Series D). Public-comp anchoring is not applicable due to unavailable revenue data for the target. The wide dispersion in peer valuations ($1.15B – $8.0B) reflects substantial heterogeneity in maturity and business model within the aerospace sector.

The two-method triangulation implies a valuation range of $69M to $2.3B, with a median of $1.0B. Key uncertainties include revenue scale relative to peers, path to profitability, and whether Orbital Sidekick's business model aligns more closely with lower-valuation Series C peers or the substantially higher-valuation Series D cohort.
